title: TAI automatic exact release chain
objective: Close the exact-main release chain without relying on issue comments: after a successful canonical image workflow for unchanged current main, execute the existing protected read-only REG.RU preflight, publish bounded evidence, dispatch the existing restricted Qwen activation, and let the existing activation workflow_run deployment continue to strict postflight.
boundaries: Automatic preflight starts only from a successful Build & Publish Canonical Docker Images workflow_run for this repository, branch main and unchanged exact current main SHA
All five canonical build jobs must be successful before preflight
The REG.RU preflight runner remains non-root, outside the Docker group, without direct Docker access and with only the protected pc-tai-release-controller sudo authority
The self-hosted preflight job contains no checkout, third-party Action or artifact Action
Only bounded canonical redacted JSON crosses from the production runner to a hosted publisher
Activation dispatch occurs only after accepted strict or exact four-blocker bootstrap evidence
The activation workflow independently re-fetches and verifies the automatic preflight run, exact SHA, branch, actor pair and all six required jobs
The existing activation controller, RU/EN/ZH and potato acceptance, Chromium acceptance, rollback and automatic standalone deployment remain unchanged
Any main movement, failed image, malformed evidence, additional blocker, failed acceptance or postflight failure remains fail-closed
No inbound production SSH, direct runner Docker authority, new sudo capability, credential, SaaS, server or recurring expense is introduced
